author: PostOakLabs
description: For one counterparty book in millions of USD, check each counterparty against its approved aggregate limit and check the book against caller-declared single-name and sector concentration policy values. Concentration follows art-445 and the limit check follows art-446, with the same typed name used in both panels and the limit type fixed to aggregate for every row. HHI is shown on the 0 to 10000 scale. Runs entirely in the browser, zero network, zero storage, deterministic.

counterparties.description: One row per counterparty: name, sector, exposure in millions of USD, approved limit in millions of USD, warning threshold percent

sector_limit_pct.description: Caller-declared sector policy limit percent, default 25

single_name_limit_pct.description: Caller-declared single-name policy limit percent, default 10

top_n.description: Number of top names shown, default 5
